articles.title: Nscale and Anthropic are reportedly in talks for yet another $45B compute deal
articles.full_text:
A little over a month ago, Anthropic and AI infrastructure provider Nscale announced a $45 billion compute deal. Now the duo may be about to do it again.

Bloomberg reports that the two companies are said to be on the verge of announcing yet another $45 billion compute deal, citing people familiar with the matter. Those sources cautioned that talks are still underway and that the details could change.

If the deal goes through, it would be the latest in a long string of giant compute deals Anthropic has struck over the past year. TechCrunch reached out to Nscale and Anthropic for more information and will update this story if we hear back.

The massive amount of money being sunk into AI compute deals has spooked a certain segment of investors, who worry that companies are spending too much money for too little profit. Still, Anthropic has pressed on with such partnerships, driven by the belief that it will all pay off in the end.

Both Anthropic and Nscale are also currently pursuing IPOs. Anthropic is still expected to go public this year. Nscale is also seeking to go public, although Bloomberg reported on Monday that the company is experiencing investor pushback over its proposed valuation of $30 billion.
articles.summary:
Anthropic and Nscale are reportedly close to announcing a second $45 billion compute deal just weeks after their first, continuing a wave of massive AI infrastructure spending. The potential agreement highlights both the scale of compute commitments in the AI sector and growing investor concerns about spending versus returns.

  • Core event: Bloomberg reports that Anthropic and Nscale are in talks for another $45 billion compute deal, though sources caution negotiations are ongoing and terms could change.
  • Background: The reported deal follows a $45 billion compute agreement between the two companies announced just over a month ago, part of a string of giant compute deals Anthropic has struck over the past year.
  • Market concern: The enormous sums flowing into AI compute deals have unsettled some investors who worry companies are spending too much for too little profit, even as Anthropic proceeds on the belief the investments will pay off.
  • IPO angle: Both Anthropic and Nscale are pursuing IPOs; Anthropic is still expected to go public this year, while Nscale is reportedly facing investor pushback over its proposed $30 billion valuation.
